checks.evidence: OBU acknowledges emergency message revocation with correct timestamp, step 2: the RBC revocation requests acknowledgement and the OBU sends an acknowledgement message.

invented: Revocation message considered inconsistent when it has invalid identifier or corrupted data, with no acknowledgement sent (consistency checks from SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 are not in the requirement)
Acknowledgement message refers to the timestamp of the revocation message
Level 2 and modes FS, OS, LS or SM as preconditions
